heading_path: Part 17A—Protected international trade marks under the Madrid Protocol
Division 10—Recording of claimed interests and rights
text: (1) Particulars recorded under this Division may be: (a) amended in accordance with subregulations 11.1(2) and (3); or (b) cancelled in accordance with subregulations 11.3(2), (3), (4) and (5). (2) Those subregulations apply for the purposes of this regulation as if a reference to the owner of the trade mark were a reference to the holder of the relevant IRDA or protected international trade mark.
title: Amendment or cancellation of record

units.text: (1) Particulars recorded under this Division may be:
(a) amended in accordance with subregulations 11.1(2) and (3); or
(b) cancelled in accordance with subregulations 11.3(2), (3), (4) and (5).

(2) Those subregulations apply for the purposes of this regulation as if a reference to the owner of the trade mark were a reference to the holder of the relevant IRDA or protected international trade mark.
